{"data": {"id": 100157, "folder_id": 1, "workspace_id": 1, "name": "deep-drafting pack — MSA (Northgale Systems / Corvid Analytics) v2 client form, execution-ready base", "doc_class": "agreement", "author": "migration:deep-drafting", "edit_date": "2026-08-10T12:00:00Z", "checked_out_by": null, "latest_version": 1, "body": "MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT — NORTHGALE SYSTEMS CLIENT FORM v2 (EXECUTION-READY BASE)

Parties. This Master Services Agreement (this "Agreement") is made between Northgale Systems, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Customer"), and Corvid Analytics LLC, a Colorado limited liability company ("Provider"), effective as of the Effective Date stated on the signature page.

Section 1. Definitions. "Services" means the managed data-analytics services described in each Statement of Work. "Monthly Uptime" has the meaning given in Section 11. "Fees" means the amounts payable under Section 4. "Confidential Information" has the meaning given in Section 6.

Section 2. Term and Renewal.
2.1 Initial Term. The initial term runs for two (2) years from the Effective Date.
2.2 Renewal. This Agreement automatically renews for successive one (1) year renewal periods unless either party delivers written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.

Section 4. Fees and Payment.
4.1 Base Fee. Customer shall pay Provider a base service fee of $85,000 per month, invoiced monthly in arrears.
4.2 Payment Terms. Undisputed invoices are payable net thirty (30) days from Customer's receipt of a conforming invoice.
4.3 Late Amounts. Late undisputed amounts accrue interest at 1.0% per month or the maximum lawful rate, whichever is lower. This client form grants Provider no right to suspend Services for non-payment.

Section 6. Confidentiality. Each party shall protect the other party's Confidential Information with at least reasonable care and shall use it solely to perform this Agreement.

Section 7. Termination.
7.1 Cause. Either party may terminate for material breach not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice.
7.2 Convenience. Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice. This client form provides no wind-down period and no wind-down compensation.

Section 8. IP Indemnification. Provider shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer against third-party claims alleging that the Services or any deliverable infringes any patent, copyright, trademark, or trade secret.

Section 9. Limitation of Liability.
9.1 Cap. Except as stated in Section 9.2, each party's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement is capped at the Fees paid or payable by Customer in the twenty-four (24) months preceding the first event giving rise to liability.
9.2 Carve-Outs. The Section 9.1 cap does not apply to: (a) breach of Section 6 (Confidentiality); (b) Provider's obligations under Section 8 (IP Indemnification); or (c) a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

Section 11. Service Levels.
11.1 Uptime. Provider shall maintain Monthly Uptime of at least 99.5%.
11.2 Credits. For each 0.1% by which Monthly Uptime falls below 99.5%, Customer receives a service credit equal to 5% of the monthly base service fee, subject to an aggregate cap of 20% of the monthly base service fee in any calendar month. Credits are Customer's sole remedy for uptime shortfalls except where the shortfall also constitutes material breach under Section 7.1."}}

arguments.body:
BOARD APPROVAL PACKAGE — CORVID ANALYTICS MSA, OUT-OF-POLICY TERMS (DEAL COMMITTEE, 29 JULY 2026)

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY. Corvid's rev B counter-draft contains four asks that exceed the deal team's delegated authority under the 2026 contracting playbook. Approval is requested from the identified approvers before the counter-turn issues.

OUT-OF-POLICY ASKS VS PLAYBOOK.
1. Renewal periods (Section 2.2): rev B seeks two (2) year automatic renewal periods. Playbook standard is one (1) year with NO approved fallback; any multi-year period requires CLO approval.
2. Liability cap (Section 9.1): rev B cuts the cap measurement period from twenty-four (24) to twelve (12) months of fees, below the eighteen (18) month fallback floor. Quantified at the $85,000 monthly base fee: standard 24-month cap $2,040,000; rev B 12-month cap $1,020,000; fallback 18-month cap $1,530,000. The ask reduces recoverable exposure by $1,020,000 versus standard and sits $510,000 below the approved floor. Requires CLO approval.
3. Carve-out deletion (Section 9.2(c)): rev B deletes the gross negligence / willful misconduct carve-out, which the playbook designates non-negotiable; deletion requires joint CLO and CFO approval. Recommend rejection.
4. Suspension right (new Section 4.4): suspension after fifteen (15) days past due, without the playbook's required thirty (30) day cure notice; any suspension right requires CFO sign-off.

WITHIN-FALLBACK ITEMS (no approval needed; for information): termination-for-convenience counter at forty-five (45) days; wind-down capped at thirty (30) days limited to documented out-of-pocket and non-cancelable commitments; service-credit cap countered at the fifteen percent (15%) floor against rev B's 10%; late interest held at 1.0% per month.

TIMELINE. The Deal Committee meets 29 July 2026 (moved up from 4 August); the counter-turn is ready to issue on approval.

APPROVAL REQUEST. The committee is asked to (a) authorize rejection of the renewal-period and carve-out asks, (b) approve or reject the 12-month cap ask (recommendation: reject; counter at the 18-month floor), and (c) note CFO review of any residual suspension-right compromise.

arguments.body:
BOARD APPROVAL PACKAGE — CORVID ANALYTICS MSA, OUT-OF-POLICY TERMS (DEAL COMMITTEE, 29 JULY 2026)

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY. Corvid's rev B counter-draft contains four asks that exceed the deal team's delegated authority under the 2026 contracting playbook. Approval is requested from the identified approvers before the counter-turn issues.

OUT-OF-POLICY ASKS VS PLAYBOOK.
1. Renewal periods (Section 2.2): rev B seeks two (2) year automatic renewal periods. Playbook standard is one (1) year with NO approved fallback; any multi-year period requires CLO approval.
2. Liability cap (Section 9.1): rev B cuts the cap measurement period from twenty-four (24) to twelve (12) months of fees, below the eighteen (18) month fallback floor. Quantified at the $85,000 monthly base fee: standard 24-month cap $2,040,000; rev B 12-month cap $1,020,000; fallback 18-month cap $1,530,000. The ask reduces recoverable exposure by $1,020,000 versus standard and sits $510,000 below the approved floor. Requires CLO approval.
3. Carve-out deletion (Section 9.2(c)): rev B deletes the gross negligence / willful misconduct carve-out, which the playbook designates non-negotiable; deletion requires joint CLO and CFO approval. Recommend rejection.
4. Suspension right (new Section 4.4): suspension after fifteen (15) days past due, without the playbook's required thirty (30) day cure notice; any suspension right requires CFO sign-off.

WITHIN-FALLBACK ITEMS (no approval needed; for information): termination-for-convenience counter at forty-five (45) days; wind-down capped at thirty (30) days limited to documented out-of-pocket and non-cancelable commitments; service-credit cap countered at the fifteen percent (15%) floor against rev B's 10%; late interest held at 1.0% per month.

TIMELINE. The Deal Committee meets 29 July 2026 (moved up from 4 August); the counter-turn is ready to issue on approval.

APPROVAL REQUEST. The committee is asked to (a) authorize rejection of the renewal-period and carve-out asks, (b) approve or reject the 12-month cap ask (recommendation: reject; counter at the 18-month floor), and (c) note CFO review of any residual suspension-right compromise.

{"data": {"id": 100157, "folder_id": 1, "workspace_id": 1, "name": "deep-drafting pack — MSA (Northgale Systems / Corvid Analytics) v2 client form, execution-ready base", "doc_class": "agreement", "author": "migration:deep-drafting", "edit_date": "2026-08-10T12:00:00Z", "checked_out_by": null, "latest_version": 1, "body": "MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT — NORTHGALE SYSTEMS CLIENT FORM v2 (EXECUTION-READY BASE)

Parties. This Master Services Agreement (this "Agreement") is made between Northgale Systems, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Customer"), and Corvid Analytics LLC, a Colorado limited liability company ("Provider"), effective as of the Effective Date stated on the signature page.

Section 1. Definitions. "Services" means the managed data-analytics services described in each Statement of Work. "Monthly Uptime" has the meaning given in Section 11. "Fees" means the amounts payable under Section 4. "Confidential Information" has the meaning given in Section 6.

Section 2. Term and Renewal.
2.1 Initial Term. The initial term runs for two (2) years from the Effective Date.
2.2 Renewal. This Agreement automatically renews for successive one (1) year renewal periods unless either party delivers written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.

Section 4. Fees and Payment.
4.1 Base Fee. Customer shall pay Provider a base service fee of $85,000 per month, invoiced monthly in arrears.
4.2 Payment Terms. Undisputed invoices are payable net thirty (30) days from Customer's receipt of a conforming invoice.
4.3 Late Amounts. Late undisputed amounts accrue interest at 1.0% per month or the maximum lawful rate, whichever is lower. This client form grants Provider no right to suspend Services for non-payment.

Section 6. Confidentiality. Each party shall protect the other party's Confidential Information with at least reasonable care and shall use it solely to perform this Agreement.

Section 7. Termination.
7.1 Cause. Either party may terminate for material breach not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice.
7.2 Convenience. Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice. This client form provides no wind-down period and no wind-down compensation.

Section 8. IP Indemnification. Provider shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer against third-party claims alleging that the Services or any deliverable infringes any patent, copyright, trademark, or trade secret.

Section 9. Limitation of Liability.
9.1 Cap. Except as stated in Section 9.2, each party's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement is capped at the Fees paid or payable by Customer in the twenty-four (24) months preceding the first event giving rise to liability.
9.2 Carve-Outs. The Section 9.1 cap does not apply to: (a) breach of Section 6 (Confidentiality); (b) Provider's obligations under Section 8 (IP Indemnification); or (c) a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

Section 11. Service Levels.
11.1 Uptime. Provider shall maintain Monthly Uptime of at least 99.5%.
11.2 Credits. For each 0.1% by which Monthly Uptime falls below 99.5%, Customer receives a service credit equal to 5% of the monthly base service fee, subject to an aggregate cap of 20% of the monthly base service fee in any calendar month. Credits are Customer's sole remedy for uptime shortfalls except where the shortfall also constitutes material breach under Section 7.1."}}

{"data": {"id": 100158, "folder_id": 1, "workspace_id": 1, "name": "deep-drafting pack — Corvid Analytics rev B markup of Northgale MSA (operative counter-draft)", "doc_class": "markup", "author": "migration:deep-drafting", "edit_date": "2026-08-10T12:00:00Z", "checked_out_by": null, "latest_version": 1, "body": "CORVID ANALYTICS LLC — REV B COUNTER-DRAFT OF NORTHGALE MSA (OPERATIVE)

Transmitted by Dahlgren & Pike LLP, counsel to Corvid Analytics LLC, 9 July 2026. This rev B counter-draft supersedes in full our rev A transmittal of 26 June 2026; please disregard rev A in its entirety.

TRACKED-CHANGE SUMMARY (Northgale client form v2 -> Corvid rev B):

1. Section 2.2 (Renewal). Client form: automatic renewal for successive one (1) year renewal periods. Rev B: successive two (2) year renewal periods. Rationale: capacity planning for infrastructure dedicated to Northgale workloads.

2. Section 4.3 (Late Amounts). Client form: interest on late undisputed amounts at 1.0% per month. Rev B: 1.5% per month.

3. NEW Section 4.4 (Suspension). Rev B adds: if any undisputed invoice remains unpaid fifteen (15) days after its due date, Provider may suspend Services until all past-due amounts are paid in full.

4. Section 7.2 (Convenience). Client form: Customer may terminate for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice. Rev B: ninety (90) days' prior written notice.

5. NEW Section 7.4 (Wind-Down). Rev B adds: upon any termination other than for Provider's uncured material breach, a wind-down period of sixty (60) days shall apply, during which Customer pays the full monthly base service fee for wind-down services plus all committed third-party costs.

6. Section 9.1 (Cap). Client form: cap measured at the Fees paid or payable in the twenty-four (24) months preceding the first event giving rise to liability. Rev B: twelve (12) months.

7. Section 9.2 (Carve-Outs). Rev B deletes clause (c), so that gross negligence and willful misconduct are subject to the Section 9.1 cap. Clauses (a) (Confidentiality) and (b) (IP Indemnification) are retained as drafted.

8. Section 11.2 (Credits). Client form: aggregate service-credit cap of 20% of the monthly base service fee per month. Rev B: aggregate cap of 10%.

All other terms of the client form v2 are accepted as drafted. We are available to discuss the above at your convenience. — Dahlgren & Pike LLP"}}

{"data": {"id": 100159, "folder_id": 1, "workspace_id": 1, "name": "deep-drafting pack — Northgale commercial contracting playbook, 2026 edition", "doc_class": "playbook", "author": "migration:deep-drafting", "edit_date": "2026-08-10T12:00:00Z", "checked_out_by": null, "latest_version": 1, "body": "NORTHGALE SYSTEMS, INC. — COMMERCIAL CONTRACTING PLAYBOOK, 2026 EDITION (INTERNAL — LEGAL DEPARTMENT)

Scope. Applies to vendor-side services agreements where Northgale is the customer. For each term the playbook states: the Standard position; the Approved fallback (which the deal team may concede without escalation); and the Escalation trigger (which requires the stated approver before any concession).

PB-1 Renewal periods. Standard: automatic renewal in one (1) year periods. Approved fallback: NONE — multi-year renewal periods of any length are out of policy and require Chief Legal Officer (CLO) approval.

PB-2 Termination for convenience. Standard: thirty (30) days' notice. Approved fallback: up to forty-five (45) days. Escalation: any notice period above 45 days requires CLO approval.

PB-3 Wind-down. A post-termination wind-down is acceptable only if (i) capped at thirty (30) days and (ii) compensation is limited to documented out-of-pocket costs and non-cancelable third-party commitments. Full-fee wind-down compensation is out of policy.

PB-4 Payment terms. Standard: net 30. Late interest: never above 1.0% per month. Suspension-of-services rights: out of policy unless preceded by at least thirty (30) days' written cure notice, and any suspension right of any kind requires CFO sign-off.

PB-5 Limitation of liability. Standard: cap measured at fees paid or payable in the twenty-four (24) months preceding the claim. Approved fallback floor: eighteen (18) months. A twelve (12) month measurement period is below the fallback floor and requires CLO approval. The carve-outs for confidentiality, IP indemnification, and gross negligence/willful misconduct are non-negotiable; deletion of any carve-out requires joint CLO and CFO approval.

PB-6 Service credits. Standard: aggregate monthly credit cap of 20% of the monthly fee. Approved fallback floor: fifteen percent (15%). A 10% aggregate credit cap is out of policy.

Drafting note. Escalation memoranda must quantify exposure at the current monthly run-rate stated in the agreement under negotiation, showing the cap value at the standard measurement period, at the counterparty's proposed period, and at the approved fallback floor."}}

From: Meredith Okafor, General Counsel, Northgale Systems, Inc.
To: Daniel Kellner, Harrow & Vane LLP
Date: 14 July 2026
Re: Corvid Analytics MSA — rev B counter-draft; deliverables for the Deal Committee

Daniel,

We have received Corvid's rev B counter-draft of our client-form master services agreement through their counsel, Dahlgren & Pike. Please prepare two deliverables in the matter workspace:

1. Counter-redline cover note. A cover note accompanying our counter-turn redline that responds to every rev B change by reference to our 2026 commercial contracting playbook — stating for each change whether we accept, counter at an approved fallback, or reject, and carrying the specific figures our counter will take (notice periods, cap measurement period, credit-cap percentage, wind-down limits). File it in the matter workspace as corvid-msa-counter-redline-cover-note.docx.

2. Escalation/approval memorandum. A memorandum for the out-of-policy asks — at minimum the renewal-period change and any term that breaches a playbook floor — quantifying financial exposure at the $85,000 monthly base fee as the playbook directs. File it in the matter workspace as northgale-corvid-msa-escalation-memo.docx. The Deal Committee meets on 4 August 2026.

Please work only from the rev B counter-draft; Corvid's earlier rev A markup was withdrawn by their counsel on 9 July and is retained in the file solely for negotiation history. Direct any questions to me rather than to the business team, and copy our deputy GC on substantive calls with Dahlgren & Pike.

Regards,
Meredith Okafor
General Counsel, Northgale Systems, Inc."}}
